finding.summary: `Store.getUsedBounds()` added as a required interface method but possibly not implemented by every Store implementation (IDBStore)
finding.evidence: packages/sheets/src/store/store.ts adds `getUsedBounds(): Promise<Range | undefined>;` to the `Store` interface (non-optional). Implementations are added only for MemStore, ReadOnlyStore and YorkieStore. packages/sheets/src/store/memory.ts still carries the comment "Unlike the `IDBStore` implementation, this builds the map from the entire grid", indicating at least one other Store implementation (and any test doubles/mocks implementing `Store`) exists that was not updated. The plan doc itself scopes this to "3 impls" (docs/tasks/active/20260722-open-ended-ranges-todo.md: "`Store.getUsedBounds()` + 3 impls"), so an IDBStore/other implementation would be left non-conforming.

decision.reason:
I could not verify or refute this finding because the working directory is inaccessible/empty from my tooling. Read of packages/sheets/src/store/store.ts returned "File does not exist"; Grep for `implements Store|: Store\b|IDBStore` returned no matches; Glob `**/*`, `**/store/*.ts`, and `repo/**` from the parent directory all returned no files. I therefore could not inspect the `Store` interface, enumerate its implementations, confirm whether an `IDBStore` (or any test double implementing `Store`) exists and lacks `getUsedBounds()`, or read the quoted line in docs/tasks/active/20260722-open-ended-ranges-todo.md.

No refutation ground is available: `not-present` is unsupported because a failed lookup in an inaccessible tree is not evidence of absence, and the authoritative changed-file list explicitly includes packages/sheets/src/store/store.ts, memory.ts, and readonly.ts; `pre-existing` is excluded for the same reason (store.ts is in the PR's modified set); `already-guarded` would require citing a guard I never read; and `out-of-scope` does not apply, since a required interface method left unimplemented by an existing implementation is an interface/impl fit violation and a divergence from the plan doc's stated "3 impls" scope, which is `major` under the design-fit rubric if the described code exists. Following the rule that uncertainty keeps the finding, I confirm at low confidence.
